decision_rules.Proceed: Use when sufficient paid demand exists, unit economics are positive, risks are manageable and a limited launch is feasible.
decision_rules.Pilot: Use when there is promising evidence but demand, repeat purchase or operational feasibility needs controlled testing.
decision_rules.Modify: Use when the product, price, customer or channel needs to change before continuing.
decision_rules.Collaborate: Use when shared production, procurement, logistics or market access would materially improve viability.
decision_rules.Test Further: Use when critical evidence is missing and no reliable decision can yet be made.
decision_rules.Pause: Use when current economics are negative or major constraints make the model unlikely to be viable.

example_decision.reason: Initial paid demand and repeat purchases exist, but sustainable monthly demand and long-term retailer behaviour are not yet sufficiently validated.
